rationale: Unparseable timestamp prevents any temporal reconstruction for that row (spec section K principle 2: "esclusione scientifica quando impedisce la ricostruzione temporale").
false_positive_risk_note: Low risk -- parsing failure is unambiguous, not a judgment call.

rationale: Out-of-order timestamp is a data-quality signal but does not by itself make the row unusable; downstream consumers can re-sort.
false_positive_risk_note: Sorting could mask a more serious device clock issue if it recurs often -- surfaced as a warning, not silently fixed.

rationale: [E0R v0.2, R1] Azione invariata. 372 dt=0: 288 con contenuto distinto (jitter di quantizzazione, pattern 2-0-2/2-0-1/1-0-2 prevalenti), 84 copie esatte (flag dedicato qc_duplicate_record). dt=0 non apre più un segmento. | v0.1: Two rows sharing a timestamp are ambiguous for time-series use but may still carry valid spatial/thermal information individually.
false_positive_risk_note: Only restrictive excludes; permissive/recommended keep both rows and rely on the warning signal.

rationale: [E0R v0.2, R1/R6] Segnale interno; non apre più segmenti (solo dt<0, qc_time_backward_dt). Alias legacy della flag table v0.1. | v0.1: Internal-only signal that feeds qc_segment_break; not exposed as an independent policy-bearing flag to avoid double-counting the same event under two names.

Legacy-compatibility alias of (qc_sampling_gap_short OR qc_sampling_gap_long). Excluded from the policy engine to avoid double-counting the same event under both the legacy and canonical names; kept as an output column for backward compatibility only.
Spec-mandated: "un gap non rende automaticamente invalidi i punti validi prima e dopo" -- a short gap is visible but never exclusionary.
false_positive_risk_note: A too-aggressive multiplier would generate warning noise on normal jitter; tunable per profile.

rationale: Spec-mandated: closes the current segment and opens a new one; does not exclude the valid points on either side.
false_positive_risk_note: A too-low long-gap multiplier over-segments a session; a too-high one merges genuinely disjoint periods (e.g. the 06-04 Bologna-Ravenna 41-minute gap) into one segment.

rationale: Row-level trigger for segment_id incrementing, already fully expressed by SEGMENT_BREAK on qc_sampling_gap_long plus qc_time_nonpositive_dt; not separately counted in severity/reasons.
Legacy-compatibility alias of qc_segment_break. Excluded from the policy engine for the same reason as qc_time_gap.

Missing lat/lon is a real data gap. Also wired directly into gps_valid in pipeline.py (outside this table) so it can no longer silently pass as gps_valid=True, closing a gap the audit found in the pre-existing pipeline.
false_positive_risk_note: Rows genuinely without GPS fix (e.g. tunnel, indoor stretch) still keep their temperature/humidity value under this policy -- only spatial eligibility is affected, not the general keep masks.

rationale: Diagnostic sub-signal feeding the qc_spatial_jump umbrella flag (with qc_isolated_position_outlier). Kept INFO_ONLY on its own to avoid the same jump event being counted twice under two flag names in qc_reason_count.
Diagnostic sub-signal feeding qc_spatial_jump, same reasoning as qc_gps_jump.
Umbrella flag (qc_gps_jump OR qc_isolated_position_outlier) carries the actual exclusionary action, so a jump detected by either method is treated once, consistently.
false_positive_risk_note: Distance-only jump detection (gps_jump) can false-positive on genuinely fast (moto) segments; the isolated-outlier 3-point test mitigates this by requiring an immediate return to trajectory, but neither is validated against ground truth in this pass.

rationale: [E0R v0.2, R5] Verifica falsi positivi richiesta dalla nota v0.1 eseguita (outputs/e0R_qc_evidence_*): il 93,5% dei punti gps_freeze (7762/8299; 2053/2236 blocchi) è in blocchi con rilascio coerente con una sosta reale (salto al rilascio <=25 m o coerente con la velocità del dispositivo; mediana 0,6 m). Regola pre-registrata (>50% soste reali) -> declassato a EXCLUDE_RESTRICTIVE come previsto dalla nota stessa. La posizione è corretta; il rischio residuo è la ventilazione, coperto da qc_low_ventilation_possible/qc_stationary. | v0.1: Spec principle K.7: a confirmed freeze must affect at least the recommended mask for spatial analysis, "dopo verifica dei falsi positivi". Set here pending the M7 quantitative false-positive check on real data (audit found up to 20.9% of rows in the worst campaign); if that check finds the impact excessive on legitimate long stops, this action should be downgraded to EXCLUDE_RESTRICTIVE and the change documented in reports/targeted_qc_implementation.md.
false_positive_risk_note: The single largest false-positive risk in this policy table -- a real, long, legitimate stop (traffic light, break) can look identical to a GNSS chip freeze from position data alone; the meteo-variation corroborating signal in gps_qc.py reduces but does not eliminate this.

rationale: Spec principle K.6: remains the more permissive companion signal to qc_gps_freeze.
false_positive_risk_note: Intentionally broad/noisy by design -- diagnostic only.

rationale: Pure descriptive signal (repeated coordinates plus both speeds near zero); closest existing proxy to the thesis's stops/traffic-lights concept but never itself exclusionary.
Raw geometric signal feeding qc_stationary/qc_possible_gps_freeze/qc_gps_freeze internally; not independently policy-bearing.
Point outside the E0 AOI polygon (Comune di Bologna GeoJSON). Severity warn under recommended per e0/qc_flag_schema_E0_v0.1.yaml; does not delete rows.
false_positive_risk_note: GPS noise near the administrative boundary can false-warn; missing lat/lon stay NA on this flag and are handled by qc_coord_missing.

rationale: Spec-mandated: always informational, never required for the recommended profile. Always NA today since no local network geometry is supplied; documented extension point only, no network calls made.

Successor to the old, dead qc_speed_disagreement formula (GPS speed vs gps.max_speed_kmh_absolute). Kept soft (restrictive-only) because the audit found genuine moto speeds up to 151 km/h in this dataset, close to or above some profiles' configured ceiling.
false_positive_risk_note: See config/threshold_provenance.csv THR-GPS-005 -- restrictive's 120 km/h ceiling is below the observed 151 km/h genuine maximum; kept EXCLUDE_RESTRICTIVE (not stronger) specifically because of this.

rationale: [E0R v0.2, R4] Azione invariata. Evidenza: 87% dei flag a 5 m/s2 hanno |a_doppler|<2 m/s2 (solo 1,1% con |a_doppler|>5), p95 errore implicito di posizione 23,8 m (<25 m, mezza cella); in crociera stabile il 16% dei punti supera 5 m/s2 (rumore da quantizzazione del timestamp: 67% dei flag cade dove dt cambia). Regola pre-registrata soddisfatta -> warn a permissive/recommended, exclude solo restrictive. | v0.1: Canonical successor to qc_impossible_acceleration (same formula). Was fully dead before this pass despite a profile-varying config value; now wired in conservatively.
false_positive_risk_note: Never validated against real acceleration distributions in this pass (the audit did not compute a per-campaign acceleration percentile table) -- restrictive-only until it is.

rationale: Deprecated legacy-compatibility alias of qc_unrealistic_acceleration, kept because tests/test_gps_qc.py::test_impossible_acceleration_is_flagged references it by name. Excluded from the policy engine to avoid double-counting.

New meaning (device-reported vs GPS-recalculated speed comparison, via speed_evidence_class). Kept soft because the audit found the two speed sources correlate anywhere from -0.056 to 0.96 across campaigns -- neither is reliable ground truth on its own, so disagreement alone is weak evidence of a data problem.
false_positive_risk_note: Urban GPS multipath (confirmed in the audit on several February campaigns) produces genuine disagreement with no data quality issue at all -- this is the primary reason the action is not stronger than EXCLUDE_RESTRICTIVE.

rationale: Spec K.4: "normalmente INFO_ONLY o WARNING_ONLY". Raw signal only, no risk judgment attached.
Same as qc_low_speed_device.

Spec K.5: must not be automatically EXCLUDE_RECOMMENDED without further evidence. Kept as a risk flag (permissive/recommended see it only as a warning); restrictive is the only profile that acts on it.
false_positive_risk_note: Night-time low speed is common and benign (no solar radiative error possible after dark) -- the day/night bucketing in ventilation_qc.py is meant to reduce, but does not eliminate, over-flagging of legitimate slow evening/night riding.

rationale: Descriptive lifecycle marker (a real stop was detected); not itself a data-quality judgment.

[E0R v0.2, R3] Curva di deviazione termica dopo la ripresa del moto vs controllo (43 eventi con riferimento 240-360 s e nessuna nuova sosta): nessun eccesso >0,1 °C con IC che esclude 0 nei primi 60 s -> WARNING_ONLY (regola pre-registrata). Potenza limitata: semi-ampiezza IC ~0,3 °C; anche il controllo positivo (avvio sessione) non è risolto. Era INFO_ONLY in v0.1; resta non escludente. | v0.1: Spec-mandated: "non escludere automaticamente tutti i punti di recupero dal profilo recommended".
false_positive_risk_note: A too-long recovery window over-flags genuinely stable post-stop readings as low-risk-but-uncertain; see the 15/30/60 s sensitivity sweep.

rationale: [E0R v0.2, R2] Dopo il fix dt=0 (solo gap reali, 110 segmenti) la curva di deviazione termica vs controllo (40 eventi valutabili) non mostra eccesso >0,1 °C con IC che esclude 0 nei primi 60 s, né per gap <60 s né >=60 s -> WARNING_ONLY (regola pre-registrata). Potenza limitata (semi-ampiezza IC ~0,2-0,4 °C). Era INFO_ONLY in v0.1; resta non escludente. | v0.1: New flag (gap-restart instability distinct from a stop-restart), same non-exclusionary treatment as qc_post_stop_recovery.
false_positive_risk_note: Same risk profile as qc_post_stop_recovery, applied after a segment break instead of a stop.

rationale: Spec K.1: physically impossible values must be excluded from all scientific masks (permissive/recommended/restrictive) and must never contribute to averages.
false_positive_risk_note: Low risk -- bounds are absolute physical limits (-40/60 C), not a judgment call; verified against real per-campaign min/max in outputs/audit/campaign_sampling_inventory.csv, all campaigns already well within bounds.

rationale: Same as qc_temp_impossible.
false_positive_risk_note: Same as qc_temp_impossible.

rationale: Same as qc_temp_impossible.
false_positive_risk_note: Same as qc_temp_impossible.

rationale: Pre-existing placeholder, never computed (always False/NA in the source code). Left as documented dead scaffolding, not removed, per the schema-stability constraint.
Same as qc_temp_suspect.
Same as qc_temp_suspect.

Spec K.9: a confirmed isolated spike must affect at least recommended. Explicitly requires the value to return toward the pre-spike level (not a sustained change) -- see qc_temp_rate_anomaly's de-escalation rule for the sustained-gradient case.
false_positive_risk_note: A rapid but real urban microclimate transition that happens to be a single sample wide (rare at 1-2 s cadence, but possible at a sharp shade/sun boundary) could be misclassified -- mitigated by the MAD-based robustness of the test, not eliminated.

rationale: Deprecated legacy-compatibility alias of qc_temp_isolated_spike (same formula, now config-driven). Kept because tests/test_meteo_qc.py references it by name in 2 tests. Excluded from the policy engine to avoid double-counting.

New, unvalidated detector -- conservative rollout (restrictive only) until real flagging rates are reviewed. De-escalates automatically when the elevated rate persists >= thermal.rate_anomaly_persistence_s, implementing the spec's explicit "un cambiamento sostenuto... non deve essere automaticamente marcato come errore" requirement.
false_positive_risk_note: Urban environments genuinely produce fast, real temperature transitions (tunnels, shaded avenues, water crossings) -- the persistence de-escalation is the primary mitigation.

rationale: Spec K.10: initially warning, salvo evidenza forte. No corroborating second temperature channel exists in the raw schema to ever promote this to a confirmed exclusion in this implementation phase.
false_positive_risk_note: A genuinely stable microclimate (e.g. a long shaded flat stretch) is indistinguishable from a stuck sensor using only this one channel -- explicitly acknowledged as a residual risk in reports/targeted_qc_implementation.md.

rationale: Spec K.8: must affect masks per profile, but only in the correctly-identified initial phase. This action now applies to the redesigned, leading-window-only flag (see stabilization.py) instead of the old whole-trip detector.
false_positive_risk_note: The redesigned detector no longer reactivates mid-trip (verified by regression test against the real 06-20 campaign where 127/130 flags previously fired after row 120) -- residual risk is limited to the initial-window boundary itself, not the rest of the trip.

rationale: [E0R v0.2, R1] Seconda e successive copie di una riga con stesso timestamp e contenuto identico (Lat, Lon, Temp, Hum, Alt, Press, Speed): nessuna informazione nuova, doppio conteggio. 84 righe in E0 (82 in una sola campagna).
false_positive_risk_note: Un sensore fermo a 1 Hz con valori quantizzati identici e timestamp duplicato verrebbe trattato come copia; con dt=0 il rischio è trascurabile.

rationale: [E0R v0.2, R1] Segnale interno dt<0: unico trigger temporale (oltre al long gap) di qc_segment_break.
